# Gerador do baseline do unknown-ratio (PLAN-175 AC-1.1). Roda o leitor nomeado e
# copia os campos dele; nenhum número é digitado aqui. cwd = raiz do repositório.
import datetime, json, os, subprocess, sys
READER = ["python3", "-B", ".claude/scripts/skill-health.py", "--include-rotated", "--since", "all", "--json"]
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable] + READER[1:], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
if p.returncode != 0:
    sys.exit("leitor rc=%d" % p.returncode)
d = json.loads(p.stdout)
warn = sum(1 for ln in p.stderr.splitlines() if ln.startswith(("[skill-health] WARN", "[skill-health] ERROR")))
head = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
out = {
    "schema": "plan175-unknown-ratio-baseline/1",
    "ac": "AC-1.1",
    "generated_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
    "head_sha": head,
    "reader_invocation": " ".join(READER),
    "state_dir_from": "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" if os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR") else "cwd",
    "generator_command": "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=<checkout do projeto> python3 -B <gerador> > <este arquivo>, "
                         "com cwd na raiz do repositório; <gerador> = o texto de generator_source",
    "generator_source": open(__file__, encoding="utf-8").read(),
    "window": d["window"],
    "log_found": d["log_found"],
    "log_files_read": [os.path.basename(x) for x in d["log_paths"]],
    "rotated_siblings_present": d["rotated_siblings_present"],
    "chain_status": d["chain_status"],
    "chain_scope": "o leitor verifica só o log primário (verify_chain(primary)); os rotacionados não são atestados",
    "reader_warnings": warn,
    "events_scanned": d["events_scanned"],
    "events_in_window": d["events_in_window"],
    "catalog_size": d["catalog_size"],
    "dead_skill_count": d["dead_skill_count"],
    "invoked_skills": {r["skill"]: r["invocations"] for r in d["skills"] if r.get("invocations")},
    "discovery_health": d["discovery_health"],
}
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
